plan.sizing_amendment: Supplementary sizing-fidelity study after the retained0.5-lot outcomes were observed. All entry/exit definitions, thresholds, dates, costs and0.75% risk remain identical. Only the paper lot ceiling is the recorded broker maximum, so the shared sizer can actually use the requested risk budget. Earlier-only nominations are repeated and locked before later/full supplementary results; both studies retained. No live setting changed.

entry_rules.common: M1 decision after its close; M5 EMA20 above/below EMA50 and EMA20 slope over3 prior M5 bars. Confirming M1 body>=60% of range; range>=1.2*mean of20 preceding M1 ranges. Sweep penetration>0.2 pip. Spread<=0.7 pip. Structure SL behind swept/last5 M1 extreme plus0.2 pip; accept only6-15 pip raw distances. No future/forming candles.
entry_rules.m1_sweep_reclaim: Previous M1 sweeps the12 preceding M1 extrema and closes back inside; current directional displacement closes beyond that sweep candle's opposite edge.
entry_rules.m1_ema_reclaim: Previous M1 sweeps4 preceding extrema and closes across M1 EMA20 against the M5 trend; current M1 reclaims EMA20 and breaks the previous candle's opposite edge.
entry_rules.m5_sweep_m1_confirm: Most recent CLOSED M5 sweeps12 preceding M5 extrema and closes back inside. A subsequent M1 closes beyond its previous2 M1 extrema within1-5 minutes after setup close; one confirmation per sweep.

plan.exits: Original2R initial target, trailing activation1.5R/gap1R, target removal at activation. Both sides capped at30 elapsed minutes, weekday entries05:00-18:00 UTC intersecting existing sessions, flat by19:00 UTC. Missing quotes cannot fabricate an earlier fill; financing remains active as violation watchdog.
plan.risk_constraints: Initial price-risk budget<=0.75%; paper volume ceiling is each symbol's recorded broker maximum, not a fixed lot size. Shared risk sizer rounds down from the requested risk budget and actual stop distance.0.75% aggregate exposure,EUR150 daily trigger,single-position rule and original3600-second cooldown retained. No widened existing stops, averaging or martingale. Margin constraints not reconstructed.
plan.confirmation_adapter: Pure prototype returns a fully confirmed entry and structural SL. Research mode confirmation=none avoids applying the old second confirmation; legacy H4 bias/order-block gates are replaced by the explicit M5 trend, sweep and structure definitions. Provider is forbidden without offline history. No live mode or configuration enabled.
plan.selection: For each pair nominate highest earlier stressed net among participating, zero-financing/non-overnight prototypes with positive earlier net; tie smaller sampled drawdown then name. Otherwise cash. Lock before later/full alternative outcomes. Run all12 models regardless of nomination. Full-period rankings are descriptive, not a replacement for earlier-only nomination.
plan.execution_optimization: Precompute causal features/signals once per window; skip only entry feature construction on minutes without a signal. Still replay every open-position M1 bar for SL/TP, fees, daily loss and time exit. Cache-vs-full-path equivalence tested for final/time/daily/stop exits in both directions.
limitations: Prices and some strategy dates were examined previously; this is exploratory comparison, not untouched holdout evidence.

Three fixed durations and one fixed daylight window, no pair-specific tuning or combinations. Initial stop remains20 pips, initial target2R, trailing activation1.5R/gap1R; this tests timed scalp exits on the existing entry family, not a new M1-only signal.
Spread cap0.9 pips remains identical across pairs; low/no participation is disclosed. Every pair/window starts independently atEUR10,000, not a concurrent portfolio.

Historical observed spreads; assumedEUR3.50/lot/side commission and0.2-pip adverse market/stop slippage. Stress doubles these and negative swap debits, credits unchanged; observed spreads unchanged and missing-spread fallback doubles1 to2 pips.

Current swap snapshot held constant over history with explicit Wednesday triple assumption after invalid weekday7 metadata. Financing is retained if a missed exit crosses rollover. Strict no-swap and no-overnight status is reported separately from profit.
Constant per-pair EUR tick valuation from historical exports. Historical margin, latency, tick paths, liquidity availability and changing broker minimum-stop requirements are not reconstructed.
Timed exits are research only; live execution/settings unchanged. No bot or orders.
Existing prices/windows have been examined repeatedly; this is exploratory entry research, not untouched holdout evidence.

All thresholds fixed before outcomes; no parameter grid, combined winner or pair-specific tuning. Earlier positive results alone cannot establish sample reliability; counts and all negative paths are disclosed.

Old M30/M1 capped30-minute records are contextual historical controls, not a new replay. Entry family, structural stop and spread gate differ; this is a complete prototype comparison, not a single-parameter attribution.
Pure entry definitions are broker-independent and reusable, but current wiring is offline-only; production execution integration is not enabled or claimed.
